# Commands: acme-api

Use pnpm (packageManager field in package.json); do not use npm or yarn. Mixing package managers creates conflicting lockfiles.

## Everyday tasks

| Task | Command | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Install | `pnpm install` | pnpm |
| Dev | `pnpm dev` | `package.json` |
| Test | `pnpm test` | `package.json` |
| Lint | `pnpm lint` | `package.json` |
| Build | `pnpm build` | `package.json` |

## Root package.json scripts

| Command | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm dev` | `turbo dev` |
| `pnpm build` | `turbo build` |
| `pnpm test` | `turbo test` |
| `pnpm lint` | `biome check .` |
| `pnpm db:up` | `docker compose up -d` |

## Workspace package scripts

Run one package's script with `pnpm --filter <package> <script>`.

| Package | Command | Runs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apps/web` | `pnpm --filter @acme/web dev` | `nuxt dev` |
